glosses: national (being part of a nation's identity or character)
national (of importance for the nation as a whole)
nationwide, national (covering a country, as opposed to regional and international levels; see usage note below)

examples.text: Tom erhielt ein Stipendium von der National Science Foundation.
examples.en: Tom received a grant from the National Science Foundation.

examples.text: Tom wurde von der National Science Foundation ein Forschungsstipendium zugesprochen.
examples.en: Tom was awarded a research grant by the National Science Foundation.
